Physical Damage is one of the Damage Types, it is mitigated by Armor and Block Armor.

## Contents

- 1 Known Modifiers

- 1.1 Character Stats

- 1.2 Affixes

- 1.3 Equipment Implicits

- 2 List of Physical Damage Skills

- 2.1 NPC

- 3 See Also

## Known Modifiers[]

### Character Stats[]

- Increased Physical Damage

### Affixes[]

- Added Melee Physical Damage (only effects Melee Attack Skills)

- Increased Minion Physical Damage

### Equipment Implicits[]

- Most Weapons have Added Melee Physical Damage

- Some One Handed Blunt Weapons and Two Handed Blunt Weapons have Increased Physical Damage
